title: Narellan Walk-in Wardrobe
summary: A master suite reworked around a custom wardrobe system — storage that finally fits the way its owners actually live.
brief: The brief was simple to say and hard to do: make the morning routine effortless. The master suite had plenty of storage on paper, but none of it suited how the owners actually dressed, packed and travelled.
We designed a custom wardrobe system and reorganised the suite around it, down to drawer inserts and lighting.

photos.heading: The Master Suite
photos.text: Built-in wardrobes in a soft white keep the room feeling larger, with everyday items at hand height and seasonal storage above.

photos.heading: The Butler's Pantry
photos.text: The same thinking carried into the kitchen: open shelving for the things used daily, closed storage for everything else.
